narrative.overview: A precise, calm, and inspectable interface built from cool protocol paper, institutional cobalt, dark control surfaces, and ruled evidence rows.

rules.name: Evidence Before Color
rules.body: Status remains understandable when color is removed.

rules.name: Paper Stack
rules.body: Elevation separates whole records, never individual data rows.

dos: Pair status color with precise text.
donts: Do not represent private thought as ground truth.
Do not use gradients, faux stamps, or thick side-tab accents.
Do not persist operator bearer credentials.
